description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeTrackerSearchFilterParams class, which extends a base FilterParams class. It is part of the OrangeHRM Performance module and encapsulates search filter parameters for employee tracker data, including sorting options, employee inclusion filters, and IDs.

classes.name: EmployeeTrackerSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object for filtering employee tracker searches within the OrangeHRM performance module, providing options for sorting, employee inclusion filters, and specific employee/tracker identifiers.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes default sort field and order for the filter parameters.

methods.name: getTrackerIds
methods.description: Returns the array of tracker IDs to filter by.

methods.name: setTrackerIds
methods.description: Sets the array of tracker IDs for filtering.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number to filter by.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number to filter.

methods.name: getIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Retrieves the current employee inclusion filter setting.

methods.name: setIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Updates the employee inclusion filter setting.
